The '''Kilia system''' contained [[Kilia IV/Legends|Kilia IV]].

This system was not on any major [[Hyperspace route/Legends|trade route]], and no one visited it on a regular basis. In fact, the star system did not appear on most astrogation charts, as it was in a portion of space labeled as [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] in most astrogation computers.
